description:
You are a farmer at GAEC JOULIN, a cereal farm in Charente-Maritime, France. You have just purchased a used Massey Ferguson 7720 tractor from a local dealer. You need to register this tractor in Ekylibre so you can assign it to upcoming field interventions (sowing, spraying, harvesting) and track its operating costs.

Navigate to the equipment management section in Ekylibre and create a new equipment record with the following details:

- Name: Massey Ferguson 7720
- Variant/Type: Select the most appropriate tractor variant available in the system (look for 'Tractor' or 'Tracteur' or any similar equipment type)
- Work number (working number / identification): MF-7720-01

Save the new equipment record. After saving, the tractor should appear in the equipment fleet list.

Note: The Ekylibre interface may be in French. Equipment is typically found under a 'Production' or 'Équipements' menu, or possibly via the top navigation or sidebar. You may need to explore the menu structure. Use the login credentials admin@ekylibre.org / 12345678 if prompted to log in.

The Ekylibre application is running at http://demo.ekylibre.farm:3000
